title: Why there's a Usave in almost every town #Shoprite
text:
Shoprite went where the people were: ordinary shoppers first, then the townships in the nineties, then in 2003 the first Usave. A Usave is small, a few hundred square metres (some are built from shipping containers), and sells a short list of basics: more than 420 products under R10, even a R1 packet of biscuits. The 500th Usave opened in August 2025, in Hopefield in the Western Cape.

Full guide: "How Shoprite Makes Money: R6 of Every R100 (and Why It's in Every Town)" on the Money From Zero channel.
